extra_quotes: To describe the 2D nonlinear dynamics, we derived nonlinearly coupled equations for the amplitudes of axial modes Aq(θ, t) under the assumption that the spatial distribution of the field does not depend on the number of the azimuthal mode for large m em(r)≡e(r), Zm,q(z)≡Zq(z).

Solving the eigenvalue problem of Eq. (2), we find the spatial distribution of modes Zl(z), with the help of which the effective volumes of modes Vijkl and the coupling coefficients of the taper with axial modes κ(c)l were determined, and also resonant frequencies ωml from the values of which the free spectral range D(1)l and the second-order dispersion of azimuthal modes D(2)l were calculated (see Table I for detailed values).

To describe the axial distribution localized in a microresonator, we neglect the losses due to radiation escaping into the continuous spectrum, scattering at infinity, and consider only the discrete set of localized axial modes.
